translations.pickthall: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
translations.khattab: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens ˹in layers˺, and likewise for the earth. The ˹divine˺ command descends between them so you may know that Allah is Most Capable of everything and that Allah certainly encompasses all things in ˹His˺ knowledge
translations.arberry: It is God who created seven heavens, and of earth their like, between them the Command descending, that you may know that God is powerful over everything and that God encompasses everything in knowledge.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

translations.saheeh: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
translations.pickthall: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
translations.khattab: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens ˹in layers˺, and likewise for the earth. The ˹divine˺ command descends between them so you may know that Allah is Most Capable of everything and that Allah certainly encompasses all things in ˹His˺ knowledge
translations.arberry: It is God who created seven heavens, and of earth their like, between them the Command descending, that you may know that God is powerful over everything and that God encompasses everything in knowledge.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةࣰ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: O believers! Turn to Allah in sincere repentance, so your Lord may absolve you of your sins and admit you into Gardens, under which rivers flow, on the Day Allah will not disgrace the Prophet or the believers with him. Their light will shine ahead of them and on their right. They will say, “Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. ˹For˺ You are truly Most Capable of everything.”
translations.arberry: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance; it may be that your Lord will acquit you of your evil deeds, and will admit you into gardens underneath which rivers flow. Upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who believe with him, their light running before them, and on their right hands; and they say, 'Our 'Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us; surely Thou art powerful over everything.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
translations.pickthall: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: Blessed be He in whose hand is the Kingdom -- He is powerful over everything --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجࣱ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
translations.pickthall: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
translations.khattab: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”
translations.arberry: and wellnigh bursts asunder with rage. As often as a troop is cast into it, its keepers ask them, 'Came there no warner to you?';

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
translations.pickthall: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.
translations.khattab: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything
translations.arberry: Have they not regarded the birds above them spreading their wings, and closing them? Naught holds them but the All-merciful. Surely He sees everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافࣲ مَّهِينٍ

translations.saheeh: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
translations.pickthall: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
translations.khattab: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker
translations.arberry: And obey thou not every mean swearer,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
translations.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
translations.khattab: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss
translations.arberry: What, is every man of them eager to be admitted to a Garden of Bliss?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
translations.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
translations.khattab: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly
translations.arberry: And whenever I called them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, and wrapped them in their garments, and persisted, and waxed very proud.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

translations.saheeh: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
translations.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
translations.khattab: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
translations.arberry: that He may know they have delivered the Messages of their Lord; and He encompasses all that is with them, and He has numbered everything in numbers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ

translations.saheeh: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
translations.pickthall: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
translations.khattab: Every soul will be detained for what it has done
translations.arberry: Every soul shall be pledged for what it has earned,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّنَشَّرَةࣰ‏

translations.saheeh: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
translations.pickthall: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
translations.khattab: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺
translations.arberry: Nay, every man of them desires to be -- given -- scrolls unrolled.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
translations.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
translations.khattab: And We have everything recorded precisely
translations.arberry: and everything We have numbered in a Book.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ شَأۡنࣱ يُغۡنِيهِ

translations.saheeh: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
translations.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
translations.khattab: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own
translations.arberry: every man that day shall have business to suffice him.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.saheeh: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
translations.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
translations.khattab: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor
translations.arberry: and none cries lies to it but every guilty aggressor.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ

translations.saheeh: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
translations.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
translations.khattab: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things
translations.arberry: God to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
translations.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
translations.khattab: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺
translations.arberry: Over every soul there is a watcher.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
translations.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
translations.khattab: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter
translations.arberry: in it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, upon every command.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيۡلࣱ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةࣲ لُّمَزَةٍ

translations.saheeh: Woe to every scorner and mocker
translations.pickthall: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
translations.khattab: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer
translations.arberry: Woe unto every backbiter, slanderer,
